s6_search_strata.C4_C8: no admissible atoms, therefore no active strata

procedure: calibration values only for predictor mean/std
standardize each coordinate with those calibration statistics
apply unchanged to protected predictor values
fit affine OLS y_cal = beta_0 + X_C,cal beta
score protected target with frozen NRMSE = RMSE_protected / std(y_cal, ddof=0)

rank_deficient_handling.note: that distinction belongs to later qualification

s8_navigation_score.definition: J_search(C) = mean over 20 development discharges of NRMSE_s(C), where NRMSE_s(C) = mean_b NRMSE_{s,b}(C) over blocks A, B, C

s10_atomic_scoring.scope: ALL admissible atoms as one-coordinate supports

s11_within_stratum_ranking.rationale: prevents large diagnostic families from receiving more initial search opportunities merely because they contain more atoms

s12_shortlist.method: per constructor, round-robin over its nonempty scientific-family strata; round r takes the r-th best atom of every stratum

s13_budget_interpretation.claim_about_rank_97: none; no claim that rank 97 is scientifically inferior
s13_budget_interpretation.stop_condition: if 96 cannot give at least one slot to every nonempty stratum of a constructor, STOP before target access

s14_greedy_search.seeds: top 1 atom by within-stratum rank per active stratum
s14_greedy_search.proposal_rule: at each step, EVERY active stratum represented in the expansion shortlist proposes exactly one atom: its highest within-stratum-ranked shortlisted atom not already in the support
s14_greedy_search.extension_filter: discard only extensions violating frozen Phi_set
s14_greedy_search.selection: lowest J_search; tie-break canonical support ID
s14_greedy_search.seed_rank_deficient_handling: if the only atom in a stratum has +infinity navigation score it is retained as the formal seed and flagged SEED_PROXY_RANK_DEFICIENT; normal path rules then determine whether useful extension is possible

s15_raw_only_lane.strata: the broad scientific families represented among C0
s15_raw_only_lane.seeds: top one C0 atom per nonempty scientific family
s15_raw_only_lane.growth: same greedy rule, one highest-ranked unused C0 atom offered per scientific-family stratum per step
s15_raw_only_lane.purpose: guarantee the explored frontier contains compact raw-only representations
s15_raw_only_lane.B2_remains: the frozen full-information raw Ridge comparator

s17_explored_definition.in_Ahat_rec_iff: its search proxy was actually evaluated
includes: every candidate multivariate extension actually scored
s17_explored_definition.PROPOSED_BUT_SET_INADMISSIBLE: outside Ahat_rec because already outside A_rec

s19_no_selection.lowest_J_search_may_be_called: lowest-navigation-score support in the explored frontier

s6_primary_vs_sensitivity.decided_by: prospective human decision, before any density value
s6_primary_vs_sensitivity.reason: computational economy while retaining one independent starting path for every active stratum

may: show whether a larger exploration frontier changes conclusions
must: preserve the present primary one-seed result
may_not: retroactively become the primary result merely because it finds a better representation
convert a failed primary q_rec into a successful primary structural-transfer claim
replace, rescue, redefine or retroactively optimize the primary one-seed result

s6_primary_vs_sensitivity.outcome_trigger_forbidden_example: 'run if the primary result is bad' - forbidden; if later authorised it is a sensitivity REGARDLESS of the primary result
s6_primary_vs_sensitivity.price_accepted_prospectively: broad in scientific opportunity, shallower in multi-start depth; reduced protection against greedy-start sensitivity. No stratum was removed to meet the budget.
